# VS Code Workspace Configuration

## Purpose
This directory provides standard workspace configurations and recommended extensions for developers contributing to NeuroFlow AI.

## Responsibility
- Define consistent editor settings (formatting, linting, indentation).
- Recommend essential extensions for Python Clean Architecture, TypeScript/Next.js, Docker, and Markdown documentation.

## What Belongs Here
- `settings.json`: Workspace editor & linter settings.
- `extensions.json`: Recommended VS Code extensions.
- Workspace launch configurations.

## What Does NOT Belong Here
- Personal developer settings or user-specific overrides.
- Hardcoded system paths or credentials.

## Future Roadmap
- Add standardized debugging and launch profiles for backend services and Next.js frontend dev servers.
